test_title: PYST 12: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 22nd November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term.
TANGY : GZMTB : : PRIEST : ?
solution:
The table is alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

TANGY : GZMTB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/115bf393cd9b31d3b3f8536af3fbd542f0aaae08cb59df515a9994196e2e6641.png] 

Similarly,

PRIEST : ?

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e91529b7924c699f965406a6187433e169fcc1d1711d98b22bb8789e4c151e0.png] 

Hence, 'PRIEST' is coded as "**KIRVHG**".
